## converting

### effectValidator

```ts
const effectValidator: <S>(
  self,
  options?,
) => StandardSchemaV1<S["Encoded"], S["Type"]> & S = Schema.toStandardSchemaV1;
```

Effect's maintained Standard Schema adapter, including nested issue paths.

Returns a "Standard Schema" object conforming to the
[Standard Schema v1](https://standardschema.dev/) specification.

**Details**

This function creates a schema whose `validate` method attempts to decode and
validate the provided input synchronously. If the underlying `Schema` includes
any asynchronous components (e.g., asynchronous message resolutions or checks),
then validation will necessarily return a `Promise` instead.

**Example** (Creating a standard schema from a regular schema)

```ts import.meta.vitest
import { Schema } from "effect";

// Define custom hook functions for error formatting
const leafHook = (issue: any) => {
  switch (issue._tag) {
    case "InvalidType":
      return "Expected different type";
    case "InvalidValue":
      return "Invalid value provided";
    case "MissingKey":
      return "Required property missing";
    case "UnexpectedKey":
      return "Unexpected property found";
    case "Forbidden":
      return "Operation not allowed";
    case "OneOf":
      return "Multiple valid options available";
    default:
      return "Validation error";
  }
};

// Create a standard schema from a regular schema
const PersonSchema = Schema.Struct({
  name: Schema.NonEmptyString,
  age: Schema.Finite.check(Schema.isBetween({ minimum: 0, maximum: 150 })),
});

const standardSchema = Schema.toStandardSchemaV1(PersonSchema, {
  leafHook,
});

// The standard schema can be used with any Standard Schema v1 compatible library
const validResult = standardSchema["~standard"].validate({
  name: "Alice",
  age: 30,
});
const invalidResult = standardSchema["~standard"].validate({
  name: "",
  age: 200,
});

if (validResult instanceof Promise || invalidResult instanceof Promise) {
  throw new Error("Expected synchronous validation");
}
if ("value" in validResult) {
  validResult.value; // => { name: "Alice", age: 30 }
}
invalidResult.issues?.map((issue) => issue.path); // => [["name"], ["age"]]
```

### SubmitResult

```ts
type SubmitResult<V> =
  | {
      kind: "saved";
      values?: V;
      message?: string;
    }
  | {
      kind: "refused";
      error?: string;
      fields?: Partial<Readonly<Record<keyof V & string, string>>>;
    };
```

What a submit handler reports. Return nothing (or `saved`) when the change
landed; return `refused` with a form-level `error` and/or per-field `fields`
messages when the server said no. Field messages clear when that field changes;
the form message clears on the next change anywhere.

#### Type Parameters

| Type Parameter                            |
| ----------------------------------------- |
| `V` _extends_ [`FormValues`](#formvalues) |

}

### useSchemaForm()

```ts
function useSchemaForm<V, Out>(options): SchemaFormModel<V>;
```

One form, declared by its schema. TanStack owns field state and timing; the
schema owns validation and parses the submitted value; the handler only sees
parsed data and reports `saved` or `refused`.

| `Out`                                                                         |

| --------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `options` | [`SchemaFormOptions`](#schemaformoptions)\<`V`, `Out`\> |

#### Returns

[`SchemaFormModel`](#schemaformmodel)\<`V`\>

### SchemaFormPresentation

```ts
type SchemaFormPresentation = object &
  Omit<FormProps, "busy" | "onSubmit" | "noValidate" | "children">;
```

How a SchemaForm presents its actions and state.

#### Type Declaration

| Name            | Type         | Description                                                                                                                       |
| --------------- | ------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `submitLabel?`  | `ReactNode`  | The primary action's label; defaults to "Save changes".                                                                           |
| `discardLabel?` | `ReactNode`  | Show a Discard action while there are unsaved changes.                                                                            |
| `onCancel()?`   | () => `void` | A secondary exit action, shown even when clean; never submits or discards.                                                        |
| `cancelLabel?`  | `ReactNode`  | -                                                                                                                                 |
| `allowClean?`   | `boolean`    | Keep the primary action available on a clean form (create forms).                                                                 |
| `footer?`       | `ReactNode`  | Replaces the SaveBar, such as a footer with a retry key; `null` drops it.                                                         |
| `children?`     | `ReactNode`  | Replaces the generated field list, for custom layouts such as Screen cells: place fields with `<FormFields model names={[…]} />`. |
| `disabled?`     | `boolean`    | Disable every field, such as while an uncertain request is retried.                                                               |

### SchemaForm()

```ts
function SchemaForm<V, Out>(props): Element;
```

A whole form from its schema: fields, sections, validation, busy state and the
SaveBar. Pass `schema`, `defaultValues` and `onSubmit`, or a `model` from
useSchemaForm when the page needs its status or a custom layout.

| --------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `props`   | [`SchemaFormProps`](#schemaformprops)\<`V`, `Out`\> |

#### Returns

`Element`

### SaveBar()

```ts
function SaveBar<V>(__namedParameters): Element;
```

The form's action row: the refused-submit error, a quiet "Unsaved changes" or
"Saved" readout, an optional Discard, and the one primary submit.
